page.title: Settings
page.description: Make Masthead yours. Changes are saved as you go.

appearance.description: Theme, colour and how your front page is laid out.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Warm paper by day, deep ink by night, or let your device decide.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.description: Used for highlights, links and the page you're on.

density.label: Density
density.description: Compact fits more stories on the screen.

cardStyle.label: Card style
cardStyle.description: How stories are laid out in lists and sections.

sidebar.label: Compact sidebar
sidebar.description: Show only icons in the sidebar to give stories more room.

typography.description: Pick the typefaces and size that are easiest on your eyes.

headlineFont.label: Headline font
headlineFont.description: Headlines on cards and the top story.

scale.label: Text size
scale.description: Scales all the text in the app.

preview.headline: Central bank holds rates steady as inflation cools for a third month
preview.summary: Policymakers said price pressures were easing faster than expected and signalled that cuts could begin early next year if the trend holds.
preview.body: The decision was widely expected. Analysts now see the first cut coming in spring, and markets stayed calm after the announcement.

locale.description: The interface language and where your news comes from.

language.label: Interface language
language.description: The news itself stays in its original language.

country.label: Country
country.description: Whose newsrooms you follow. Six countries are covered today; more are on the way.

city.label: City or region
city.description: Fills your Local page with news from around you.

interests.description: The topics you follow shape your For You page and the order of sections on Home.
interests.keepOne: Keep at least one topic selected.

sources.description: Switch any outlet on or off. Switched-off sources are never fetched.

page.title: Sources
page.description: Choose the outlets that feed your front page. Switched-off sources are never fetched, and your choices are saved.

sources.cityOnly_one: {{count}} local outlet waits for its city
sources.cityOnly_state_one: {{count}} local outlet waits for its state
sources.cityOnly_land_one: {{count}} local outlet waits for its state
sources.cityOnly_area_one: {{count}} local outlet waits for its area
sources.cityOnly_other: {{count}} local outlets wait for their city
sources.cityOnly_state_other: {{count}} local outlets wait for their state
sources.cityOnly_land_other: {{count}} local outlets wait for their state
sources.cityOnly_area_other: {{count}} local outlets wait for their area
sources.localNote: Local outlets are fetched only for your selected city.
sources.localNote_state: Local outlets are fetched only for your selected state.
sources.localNote_land: Local outlets are fetched only for your selected state.
sources.localNote_area: Local outlets are fetched only for your selected area.

health.failing_other: None of its {{count}} feeds responding · tried {{time}}
health.localIdle: Fetched when its city is selected
health.localIdle_state: Fetched when its state is selected
health.localIdle_land: Fetched when its state is selected
health.localIdle_area: Fetched when its area is selected

toast.allOffHint: Every source is off, so your front page will be empty.
toast.restored: Sources are back to their defaults

reading.description: How stories open when you click them.

mode.label: Open stories as
mode.description: Web page shows the original site. Reader mode shows just the text, in your reading font.

ads.label: Block ads and trackers
ads.description: Keeps the built-in browser fast and private.

notifications.description: Stay on top of big stories without keeping an eye on the app.

breaking.label: Breaking news alerts
breaking.description: Get a desktop notification when a breaking story comes in.

updates.description: How often Masthead checks every source for new stories.
updates.failed: Couldn't refresh right now. Please try again.

interval.label: Check for news every
interval.description: Checks are light: feeds that haven't changed aren't downloaded again.

data.description: Your reading history, a fresh start, and a little about Masthead.

history.label: Reading history
history.description_one: {{count}} story in your history, stored only on this device.
history.description_other: {{count}} stories in your history, stored only on this device.
history.confirmDescription_one: {{count}} story will be removed from your history. Saved stories stay.
history.confirmDescription_other: {{count}} stories will be removed from your history. Saved stories stay.

reset.label: Reset all settings
reset.description: Everything goes back to the defaults and the welcome tour runs again. Saved stories and history are kept.
reset.confirmDescription: Your theme, fonts, sources and interests go back to the defaults, and the welcome tour starts again. Saved stories and history are kept.

appUpdates.hourly: Checks for a new version every hour.
appUpdates.availableManual: {{version}} is out — download it from GitHub.
appUpdates.failed: Couldn't check for updates. It will try again within the hour.
appUpdates.web: The browser version updates from source: run git pull.
appUpdates.manualNote: This copy (portable, macOS or .deb) can't install updates itself; you'll be told when a new version is out.

auto.label: Install updates automatically
auto.description: Masthead checks every hour, downloads new versions in the background and asks you to restart.

muted.description: Stories that mention these words disappear from every page — and never set off a breaking-news notification.
muted.label: Word or phrase to mute
muted.hint: Case and accents don't matter. Words of four letters or more also hide their other forms: “election” hides “elections” too.
muted.full: You can mute up to {{count}} words.
muted.hidden_zero: No story mentions them right now.
